faction.name: Ironclad
faction.subtitle: Strength in the struggle
faction.description: Armored warbands gather fury as they fight. Hold the line, build momentum, and break the enemy stronghold.

worker.name: Scrapper
worker.description: Harvest timber, ore and crystal. Raise and repair your settlement.

melee.name: Ironjaw
melee.description: Armored front line. Sustained attacks build Fury, granting up to 40% damage and 15% attack speed.

ranged.name: Boltspitter
ranged.description: Crossbow volleys punish exposed enemies. Builds Fury with each hit.

special.name: Wardrum
special.description: Heavy shock infantry. Fury makes prolonged brawls devastating.

cavalry.name: Boar Rider
cavalry.description: Fast raider. Strong against ranged troops; vulnerable to pikes.

spear.name: Pikejaw
spear.description: Long pike infantry. Deals triple damage to cavalry.

siege.name: Iron Catapult
siege.description: Long-range siege engine. Deals quadruple damage to buildings. Protect it from raiders.

hq.name: Iron Hall
hq.description: Your stronghold. Trains Scrappers and supports 12 population.

tower.name: Watchtower
tower.description: Defends nearby ground with heavy bolts.

wall.name: Stone Wall
wall.description: A durable barrier. Siege engines break walls quickly.

gate.name: Town Gate
gate.description: Open to let armies pass. An open gate also admits enemies. Cannot close on a unit.

iron-command.name: Iron Command
iron-command.description: Target allied ground within 8 tiles. Nearby allies gain 25% damage for 8 seconds.

queen-step.name: Queen’s Step
queen-step.description: Target visible open ground within 7 tiles to blink there and heal nearby allies.

thane-ward.name: Thane’s Ward
thane-ward.description: Target an allied unit within 8 tiles. Restore 80 health and grant 4 armor for 10 seconds.

soul-drain.name: Soul Drain
soul-drain.description: Target a visible enemy unit within 7 tiles. Deal 60 damage and recover 45 health.

admiral-wave.name: Admiral’s Wave
admiral-wave.description: Target visible ground within 8 tiles. Allies recover 50 health; hostile units take 35 damage.

prime-shield.name: Prime Shield
prime-shield.description: Target an allied machine within 8 tiles. Restore its shield and grant 4 armor for 10 seconds.

impact-fury.name: Impact Fury
impact-fury.description: Gain 35% damage for 6 seconds. Existing anti-cavalry counters still apply.

forest-leap.name: Forest Leap
forest-leap.description: Target visible open ground within 5 tiles to leap across the forest.

armored-brace.name: Armored Brace
armored-brace.description: Brace for 8 seconds, gaining 5 armor while movement slows by 25%.

terror.name: Dread Charge
terror.description: Nearby hostile infantry flee for 3 seconds; illusions and raised troops are immune.

wet-surge.name: Wet-ground Surge
wet-surge.description: On mud or shallows, gain 60% speed and 20% damage for 8 seconds.

shield-dash.name: Shield Dash
shield-dash.description: Spend 15 shield to dash up to 4 tiles toward visible open ground.

incendiary-shell.name: Incendiary Shell
incendiary-shell.description: Spend 8 wood to ignite the next shell and nearby targets for 6 seconds.

rooting-shell.name: Rooting Shell
rooting-shell.description: Spend 6 crystal to root targets hit by the next shell for 4 seconds.

ammunition-cannon.name: Deploy Ammunition
ammunition-cannon.description: Deploy and buy 5 ammunition for 15 ore. Moving packs up; deploy remaining ammunition again for free.

corpse-shell.name: Corpse Bombardment
corpse-shell.description: Consume a nearby visible corpse to charge the next area shell.

flood-shell.name: Flood Shell
flood-shell.description: Spend 6 crystal to slow troops near the next impact for 6 seconds.

powered-beam.name: Power Beam
powered-beam.description: Spend 8 crystal to power 4 beam shots. Beam damage pierces armor.

surge.name: Returning Tide
surge.description: Restore 35 HP to allies within 5 tiles and grant 25% movement speed for 6 seconds.

ward.name: Restore Wards
ward.description: Restore 24 shield to friendly machines within 5 tiles.

entrench.name: Emplace / Pack up
entrench.description: Hold position and prepare for 3 seconds to gain armor and damage. Cannons also gain range. Movement cancels emplacement.

raise.name: Raise Fallen
raise.description: Consume up to two nearby corpses to raise temporary Boneguards. Requires free population.

momentum.name: War Cry
momentum.description: Build a burst of Fury. Sustained attacks keep the momentum alive.

illusion.name: Veil Doubles
illusion.description: Conjure two short-lived doubles that draw attacks and deal reduced damage.

heal.name: Renewal
heal.description: Restore health to nearby friendly units.

town-age.name: Town Age
town-age.description: Unlock advanced troops, fortifications and expansion strongholds.

citadel-age.name: Citadel Age
citadel-age.description: Unlock siege engines and veteran military technology.

core:ranged-focus.name: Focused Volleys
core:ranged-focus.description: Ranged troops deal another 25% damage. Locks Skirmish Drills.

core:ranged-mobility.name: Skirmish Drills
core:ranged-mobility.description: Ranged troops move 25% faster. Locks Focused Volleys.

faction.name: Wild Court
faction.subtitle: The forest remembers
faction.description: Swift woodland defenders weave deceptive doubles and recover beneath healing groves. Strike, vanish, and return.

worker.description: Gather timber, ore and crystal. Cultivate the living buildings of the Court.

melee.name: Thornblade
melee.description: Swift spear guardians. Reposition quickly and protect fragile casters.

ranged.name: Mothbow
ranged.description: Long-range arrows and quick wings reward careful positioning.

special.name: Veilweaver
special.description: Conjures temporary doubles to draw enemy attacks. Activate with Q.

hq.name: Elderheart
hq.description: The heart of your settlement. Trains Tenders and supports 12 population.

depot.name: Moonwell
depot.description: Resource drop-off. Passively heals nearby friendly units at 2.5 HP/s within 6 tiles. Adds 10 population capacity.

tower.description: A living defensive spire that guards the surrounding grove.
